title: Windy Castle
hook: 一家人开车去风之城堡，路上玩起了“我看见”，猪爸爸却不认路，最后靠打电话问路才到。

cells.q: Where is the family going today?
cells.a: They are going out for the day to Windy Castle.
cells.cn: 他们今天要出门去风之城堡。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig ask Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She asked him, “Are you sure, Daddy Pig?”
cells.cn: 她问他：“你确定吗，猪爸爸？”

cells.q: What game are they playing in the car?
cells.a: They are playing I spy with my little eye.
cells.cn: 他们在玩“我用小眼睛看见”的游戏。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask about the red thing?
cells.a: She asked if it is something in the car.
cells.cn: 她问那是不是车子里的东西。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig want to know?
cells.a: She asked how they get to Windy Castle from here.
cells.cn: 她问从这里怎么去风之城堡。

cells.a: Daddy Pig is doing the map-reading, but they are lost.
cells.cn: 猪爸爸在看地图，可他们迷路了。

cells.q: What did they say to the car?
cells.a: They said, “Come on, car! You can make it!”
cells.cn: 他们喊：“加油，车子！你能行的！”

cells.q: What did Peppa want to do at the castle?
cells.a: She wanted to look through the telescope first.
cells.cn: 她想先用望远镜看一看。

cells.a: He is waving at Granny and Grandpa from the top.
cells.cn: 他在城堡顶上向爷爷奶奶挥手。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: castle, car, spy, map, lost, telescope
helper.actions: drive, play, ask, read, climb, wave

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Windy Castle”.
ending: In the end, they see Granny and Grandpa from the castle top. My favourite part is ______.
